external_conformance: STE-inspired; BCP 14 requirement keywords; no claim of ASD-STE100, EARS, PROV-O or production ontology conformance

authoring.atomic_unit: one civic treatment or attributed proposition, not one arbitrary text window
authoring.multi_treatment_behavior: split into linked claims; scalar diagnostic returns ambiguous
authoring.unknown_body_behavior: retain source/index labels separately and request resolution
authoring.uncertain_audio_behavior: preserve noisy text and abstain on unsupported details

limitations: An equal ledger can still be false or incomplete at extraction time.
Free wording is not mechanically entailed by this guard; it needs rendering constraints or semantic review.
Empty collections mean no populated values in this bounded ledger, not proof of absence in the meeting.
The equality guard intentionally rejects semantic edits, even valid corrections; corrections use a new version and a review trail.
Action labels concern mentions in selected excerpts; they do not prove passage, legal effect, payment or performance.
No independent model calls or original-audio verification.
The scalar v3 probe detects only selected multi-treatment forms and does not implement event splitting.
